thread:
Olivia: FYI hit a reproducible UI hitch in sampleapp after bumping kotlin-sdk -> 2.4.0. When token refresh happens on 401 the app UI stutters ~700-1200ms on Pixel 8 / Android 14 emulator.
Devon: Oof. Is that coming from Retrofit/OkHttp or our token plumbing? Any stack traces?
Olivia: Repro is tiny: TokenInterceptor uses runBlocking to call tokenRepo.getToken() inside intercept(). On failure path OkHttp triggers Authenticator -> interceptor path -> nested runBlocking. Sometimes I see `java.lang.IllegalStateException: Main dispatcher missing` and sometimes the main looper is starved.
Liam: runBlocking in interceptors is a common footgun. If tokenRepo uses suspend helpers that switch contexts (e.g. withContext(Main)) you can end up scheduling onto the main thread and blocking it.
Olivia: Snippet:
```
class TokenInterceptor : Interceptor {
  override fun intercept(chain: Interceptor.Chain): Response {
    val token = runBlocking { tokenRepo.getToken() }
    val req = chain.request().newBuilder()
      .header("Authorization", "Bearer $token")
      .build()
    return chain.proceed(req)
  }
}
```
Sanjay: We hit this in CI too. Root cause in our sample tokenRepo test helper which used `CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.Main).launch { ... }` for simplicity. On emulators without Main dispatcher configured you get that exception.
Devon: Two-pronged fix: update sampleapp to show a sync cache + background refresher pattern, and document "never block network hooks on Main". Also add comments in Kotlin sample that if you must block, use Dispatchers.IO and prefer a single-flight refresh to avoid thundering.
Liam: Other gotcha: OkHttp's Dispatcher has a limited thread pool; blocking interceptors can starve it and delay other calls. Also CallTimeout and per-call timeouts interplay weirdly if you block inside interceptors.
Olivia: Repro steps I used: install debug sampleapp -> set network to 3G -> login -> trigger token expiry with test-account -> watch visible UI hang + emulator log.
CI-Bot: CI: flaky test https://ci/internal/issue/5412 observed on API 34 emulator.
Devon: I'll open a small PR to change TokenRepo to `withContext(Dispatchers.IO)` for refresh and add a sync token cache example plus a quick unit that simulates Authenticator path on main thread.
Sanjay: Also add a note in the SDK docs under "Android integration" about coroutine dispatchers and interceptor/Authenticator patterns.
Olivia: I can draft the auth-queue sample (single-flight refresh, replay requests). That'd help parity with the Java example which uses blocking refresh.
Devon: Perfect. PR #1145 created with sampleapp change + doc note.
Olivia: :thumbsup: I'll attach the repro gist in the PR.
